title: [SBW] ARMA Tactical
description: An addon for SuperbWarfare that turns Minecraft into a hardcore cubic milsim.
body:
The mod adds a customizable team match mode with automatic weapon distribution for teams and a class system.

Works in singleplayer/lan game too.

Languages: EN/RU

!This mod can be installed on both the client and the server together with clients!

Tested on SBW 0.8.8

!There is auto-integration with Simple Voice Chat (players are automatically split into groups).!

Admin commands (OP):

    /arma setspawn blue/red — sets team spawn points before the match starts.

    /arma start/stop — starts/ends a round at any time.

    /arma massacre — after the match starts, activates a 50/50 mode where half of the random players are forbidden from using suppressors (fix for night battles).

    /arma attachments — lists banned attachments via the SBW H menu.

    /arma allow/disallow <barrel, scope, grip, stock, magazine> — manually bans specific mod attachments.
